newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Bank, Royal Sun to cooperate.
newsitem.headline: HK Bank, Royal Sun to cooperate.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc to provide non-life insurance products in certain Asia-Pacific countries.

Hongkong Bank, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, said the two companies would cooperate in marketing, promoting and selling some personal insurance products through HSBC Group branches and to HSBC Group customers in areas where Hongkong Bank's insurance arm, HSBC Insurance, was not licensed to operate.
The agreement would cover most areas of the Asia-Pacific region but excluded Hong Kong and Singapore, where the bank could offer its own insurance products, it said.
"Royal SunAlliance offers the best overall regional presence to complement the existing serviced provided by HSBC Insurance," David Eldon, Hongkong Bank's chief executive, said in a statement.
